akun_nama_panggilan_panjang.name: akun_nama_panggilan_panjang
akun_nama_panggilan_panjang.value: "akun"."nama_panggilan" IS NULL OR char_length("akun"."nama_panggilan") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

harga_level_mode_konsisten.name: harga_level_mode_konsisten
harga_level_mode_konsisten.value: ("harga_level"."mode" = 'PERSEN' AND "harga_level"."harga_jual_rp" IS NULL) OR ("harga_level"."mode" = 'RUPIAH' AND "harga_level"."margin_persen" IS NULL)

satuan_jual_isi_sesuai_jenis.name: satuan_jual_isi_sesuai_jenis
satuan_jual_isi_sesuai_jenis.value: ("satuan_jual"."jenis" = 'PCS_1' AND "satuan_jual"."isi_satuan_dasar" = 1) OR ("satuan_jual"."jenis" = 'PCS_3' AND "satuan_jual"."isi_satuan_dasar" = 3) OR ("satuan_jual"."jenis" = 'LUSIN' AND "satuan_jual"."isi_satuan_dasar" = 12) OR "satuan_jual"."jenis" IN ('DUS', 'KOLI')
